title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Irritable Bowel Syndrome
intro: Herbal creams for Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) are topical creams or ointments that combine natural herbs with emollients to provide relief from the symptoms of IBS, such as abdominal pain, bloating, and constipation. These creams have gained popularity due to their potential benefits, including reducing inflammation, promoting relaxation, and improving digestion. Examples of herbal creams that may help alleviate IBS symptoms include aloe vera gel, which soothes the digestive tract; peppermint oil, which relaxes the muscles and reduces spasms; chamomile, which calms the nervous system and promotes relaxation; and ginger, which has anti-inflammatory properties that may ease abdominal pain. Additionally, other herbal creams containing licorice root, triphala, and slippery elm may also be beneficial in treating IBS due to their ability to soothe and protect the mucous membranes in the digestive tract.

preparations.preparation_desc: Zingiber officinale creams, derived from the rhizomes of the ginger plant, possess anti-inflammatory properties that help to alleviate the symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The bioactive constituents of Zingiber officinale creams, including gingerols and shogaols, have been shown to reduce inflammation and modulate the gut-brain axis, thereby providing relief from IBS symptoms. By reducing inflammation and improving gut motility, Zingiber officinale creams help to alleviate abdominal pain, bloating, and altered bowel habits associated with IBS. The benefits of using Zingiber officinale creams to treat IBS include reduced symptoms, improved quality of life, and a decrease in the need for pharmaceutical medications.

By reducing inflammation and promoting the growth of beneficial gut bacteria, Curcuma longa creams may help to improve IBS symptoms and overall gut health. The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams to treat IBS include reduced symptoms, improved quality of life, and a potential reduction in the need for conventional medications.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of gastrointestinal and liver diseases : JGLD", Curcuma longa creams for irritable bowel syndrome containing curcumin and fennel essential oil significantly improved symptoms and quality of life in patients with IBS, with a 50.05% relative decrease in IBS-SSS score and a higher percentage of symptom-free patients compared to placebo after 30 days of treatment.
